text: During the year, the Ackerman family's voting interest reduced from approximately 49.0% to 36.8%.
short: The Ackerman family holds a 36.8% voting interest in Pick n Pay.

source.name: Pick n Pay Integrated Annual Report 2026 (PDF)
source.quote: During the year, the Ackerman family’s voting interest reduced from approximately 49.0% to 36.8%.

additionalSources.name: Retail Insight Network: Ackerman family cedes controlling stake in SA retailer Pick n Pay
additionalSources.quote: Following the disposal, the Ackerman family’s voting interest in Pick n Pay will decrease from 49% to 36.8%.
additionalSources.note: Reports the November 2025 accelerated bookbuild (64 million shares, R1.6bn) and that the family remains the retailer's anchor shareholder.
